name: Armoni
bio: Armoni was a son of Saul by his concubine Rizpah daughter of Aiah. When a three-year famine struck Israel and the LORD revealed it was due to Saul's bloodguilt against the Gibeonites, David handed over seven of Saul's descendants for the Gibeonites to execute; Armoni and his brother Mephibosheth were among them, put to death at the beginning of the barley harvest (2 Samuel 21:1-9).
